_readme: Influencer discount codes. This file lives outside the web root and is never reachable by URL.
Every valid code gives the buyer the same discount (set by pricing.discountPercent in products.json:
10% off $99.00 = $89.10) and owes that influencer the same flat commission (pricing.commissionCents: $50.00).
code       Letters, digits and dashes only. Not case sensitive: VEYL10 and veyl10 are the same code.
influencer A name for your own records. It is never shown on the website.
active     true for a working code. Set to false to switch a code off without deleting its history.
products   "all", or a list of product slugs the code works for, e.g. ["car-buying-out-the-door-guide"].
note       Free text for your own records. Optional.
Several influencers may have their own code for the same product. Reports are kept per code,
so each one is paid for the sales their own code brought in.
The entry below is a disabled example. It cannot be used by anyone while "active" is false.
To add a real code, copy the example, give it a new code and name, and set "active" to true.

codes.influencer: Example entry — not a working code
codes.note: Template only. Copy this line, change the code and name, then set active to true.
